current.text: Bane is a projected starter for Orlando next to Suggs, Franz Wagner, Banchero and Carter.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, so player roles may change.
Much of his production last season came while Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs were out for long stretches.
Experts expect less from him with Wagner and Banchero healthy. They see him as a third option, projected under 22% usage and under 32 minutes.
His three-point attempt rate has come down. He started last season badly but shot 41% from three after December 1.
Josh doubts he will play every game again.
Experts think his rank is too high on both sites. They say not to take him inside the top 50 and call him a bust at rank 47.
He is in tier five in both the shooting guard and the small forward tier rankings.
In an auction mock, Josh valued him at about 20 USD but did not want him. He sold for 11 USD.
Orlando is projected to win 47 or 48 games and finish as the 6th seed.

durable.text: FT% is his best category. He shoots about 90% on about 4 attempts per game, which clearly helps a team's FT%.

note: Experts agree that his rank (Yahoo 48, ESPN 41) depends on a role he had while Wagner, Banchero and Suggs were out, so he is a fade at Yahoo's 22 USD value and the 22 USD our league paid last season. The market average costs (9.1 USD on Yahoo, 12.7 USD on ESPN) and the 11 USD mock sale are a fairer range. At that price he fits any build as a source of FT%, points and some threes, and he has no weak category to plan around. Early in the season, check his minutes, usage and three-point volume next to a healthy Banchero and Wagner under the new coach.
